mapper.sql: SELECT config_id, company_id, config_key, config_value, config_name, config_group, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM fin_fiscal_config
mapper.select:
AND config_key LIKE CONCAT('%', #{configKey}, '%')
AND config_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{configName}, '%')
AND config_group = #{configGroup}
AND del_flag = '0'
ORDER BY config_group, config_key
WHERE config_group = #{configGroup} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY config_key
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fin_fiscal_config (config_key, config_value, config_name, config_group, company_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) VALUES (#{configKey}, #{configValue}, #{configKey}, 'custom', 0, #{updateBy}, sysdate(), #{updateBy}, sysdate()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE config_value = #{configValue}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate()

INSERT INTO fin_fiscal_config (config_key, config_value, config_name, config_group, company_id, create_by, create_time, remark) VALUES (#{configKey}, #{configValue}, #{configName}, #{configGroup}, #{companyId}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE fin_fiscal_config SET del_flag = '2', update_time = sysdate() WHERE config_key = #{configKey}
mapper.select: SELECT c.config_id, c.material_id, m.material_code, m.material_name, c.cost_method, c.tax_included, c.effective_date, c.company_id, c.status, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.remark FROM fin_cost_method_config c LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.material_id = c.material_id AND m.del_flag = '0' WHERE c.config_id = #{configId} AND c.del_flag = '0'

SELECT config_id, material_id, cost_method, tax_included, effective_date, company_id, status FROM fin_cost_method_config WHERE material_id = #{materialId} AND del_flag = '0' AND status = '0' AND effective_date <= CURDATE() ORDER BY effective_date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT config_id, material_id, cost_method, tax_included, effective_date, company_id, status FROM fin_cost_method_config WHERE material_id IS NULL AND del_flag = '0' AND status = '0' AND effective_date <= CURDATE() ORDER BY effective_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fin_cost_method_config WHERE material_id IS NOT NULL AND del_flag = '0'
